<function name="IsFlat" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this Nav Area is flat within the tolerance of the **nav_coplanar_slope_limit_displacement** and **nav_coplanar_slope_limit** convars.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this CNavArea is mostly flat.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
